# ZothOS Linux v3.2 (zoth-pill) — Machine-Readable LLM & Agent Context (llms.txt)
> The Operating System Built for AI Agents — And the Humans Who Command Them
> Engineered by Neal Frazier Tech (@1nc0gn30) • NullAI Platform (https://nullai.tech)
> Canonical URL: https://zothos.nullai.tech

## Dual-Sovereignty Core Architecture (For Autonomous AI Agents × For Human Operators)
- **What it is**: Debian 13 (Trixie) live/install ISO with KDE Plasma 6.3 Wayland and Debian’s stock Linux 6.12 kernel. Kali Rolling and Parrot Security are APT-pinned at 400. Canonical repo: https://github.com/NullAITech/zoth-os
- **Published download**: GitHub release v3.2.0 (2026-10-13). Five parts `zothos-3.2-amd64.iso.part00`–`part04`, plus `zothos-join-iso.sh`, `SHA256SUMS`, and `SHA256SUMS.cosign.bundle`. Join script checks SHA-256. Flash `zothos-3.2-amd64.iso` to a USB of at least 16 GB. No qcow2 asset is published.
- **Git main after that ISO**: Still version 3.2.0 through 2026-10-23. Adds four desktop folders, `zoth-control-center` v2.0, `zoth-ascii-magic` v2.7.0, and local CLIs `zoth-city-desk`, `zoth-swarm-quorum`, `zoth-gesture-map`, `zoth-surface-sentinel`, `zoth-yara-forge`, and `zoth-theme-forge`. Those scripts are not in the tagged ISO.
- **Security packages**: About 75 packages from `config/package-lists/30-opsec.list.chroot` and `40-security.list.chroot` (22 + 53). Not 175.
- **MCP**: `/etc/zothos/mcp-servers.json` has 152 catalog entries. The v3.2.0 release notes say every entry is disabled until you enable it. `zoth-relay` listens on `127.0.0.1:8765`.
- **Vault**: `zoth-vault` on `127.0.0.1:8787`. The README describes Argon2id and ChaCha20-Poly1305 and says the daemon is a prebuilt binary, so those crypto details are not auditable from the public tree.
- **Desktop modes**: `zoth-mode` accepts `gold`, `ghost`, `matrix`, and `incognito` (alias `win11`). `zoth-cockpit` on current main also cycles a cyan reality. `zoth-thermal` can set Intel `no_turbo`. It does not guarantee 55°C or 0 RPM fans. `zoth-heal` repairs APT, display, network/Tor, disk, audio, Python/MCP, and desktop config.
- **Studio CLI (do not confuse with the ISO)**: `npx @nullaitech/zoth` and `npx @nullaitech/zoth studio` (https://zoth.nullai.tech, repo NullAITech/zoth-studio-v2). The OS catalog dated 2026-10-22 lists 62 tools (45 browser workstations and 17 enclaves).
- **Third-party clients**: The README names Google Antigravity, Aider, Cursor, Grok Bot, Claude Code, Cline, and Ollama. These are not NullAI partnerships with xAI, Cursor, Anthropic, Google, or Meta. You bring your own accounts. Ollama is the local model runner.
- **Live users**: `zoth`, `azoth`, and `root`. Password `zoth`. `zoth-auth-init` deletes the old `neo` account on boot. Passwordless sudo for `zoth` and `azoth` is documented in SECURITY.md.
